name: TC Markdown Reader
description: Read and parse Markdown files: extract full content, heading structure, or content under a specific heading. Path-restricted file access for security.
description_zh: 读取和解析 Markdown 文件：提取全文、标题结构、指定标题下的内容。路径受限访问保障安全。

directives.description: Read full content of a Markdown file. Path must be under allowed base directory.
directives.description_zh: 读取 Markdown 文件全文。路径需在允许的基础目录下。

params_desc.path: File path (absolute or relative to base directory)

directives.description: Extract heading structure from a Markdown file. Returns level, text, and line number for each heading.
directives.description_zh: 提取 Markdown 文件的标题结构。返回每个标题的级别、文本和行号。

directives.description: Extract content under a specific heading until the next same-or-higher-level heading.
directives.description_zh: 提取指定标题下的内容，直到遇到同级或更高级标题为止。
